beaches.name: Lia
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported across the beach, mostly at the northern end. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2003 to 2023, a 2018 review and local guides call it the island's nudist beach; one 2013 report describes police telling bathers to dress. Guides that call it 'official' name no authority.

beaches.name: Maliadiko
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across this remote south-west beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2020 to 2023 and a 2018 local blog post calls it that year's nudist beach; one 2021 report found it fully clothed on a second visit. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Karavi
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the left (northern) part of the beach near Livadi. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2021; a 2021 report found only topless bathers and houses overlooking the beach. Local guides call it a nudist beach; no authority is named.
